editorial:
Imagine being part of the coolest, smartest group at a fancy private school. That is exactly where Virginia is, but her life is far from perfect. As her 18th birthday gets closer, her friends start turning up dead in really gross and scary ways. The weird part is that Virginia keeps blacking out and forgetting where she has been. You will feel her panic as she wonders if she is actually the killer without even knowing it. The whole movie has a creepy, old-school vibe that makes you feel like something bad is hiding around every corner of the campus.

What really works here is the mystery and the way it keeps you guessing until the very end. Some of the acting feels a bit stiff, which is common for movies from this era, but the twists make up for it. If you love a good whodunit with some blood and gore, you should definitely give this a try. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or stream it on Prime Video. If you are a big fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the best way to see all the details clearly.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Virginia has a split personality. Because of a bad accident in her past, she created a second, evil persona to deal with her trauma. This second personality is the one killing her friends. In the final scenes, she realizes she is the monster she was afraid of. The movie ends on a dark note as her killer side takes over completely, showing that the real Virginia is gone for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school slashers and plot twists.
